title: SkyrimNet MiniGame
tagline: Play Reversi, Liar's Dice, Shut the Box, Blackjack and Texas Hold'em with the NPCs around you on a board drawn over the game. Your opponents talk about the game, know how it stands, and remember it.
description:
Play table games with the people around you. Open the menu, pick a game and your opponents from the NPCs nearby, and play on a board drawn over the game. SkyrimNet gives your opponents a voice: they talk about the game as it goes, know how it stands, and remember it afterwards.

### Games

- **Reversi** (Othello) against one NPC, at four strengths, with legal-move hints.
- **Liar's Dice** against one to three NPCs. Everyone hides five dice under a cup, ones are wild; in turn you raise the bid on the whole table's dice or call the last bid a lie. The game plays to the end: once you are out, the others play on while you watch.
- **Shut the Box** against one to three NPCs. Roll the dice and shut the numbered tiles that add up to the roll. The tiles left open are your score, and the lowest score wins; shutting every tile wins at once.
- **Blackjack** against one to three NPCs. Choose who deals when the game starts, you or one of them; the dealer stays the same until the game ends, holds no chips and can always pay. The others start with 100 chips, and the most chips after the last round wins. When you deal, you see the other hands and may draw or stand on 17 or more.
- **Texas Hold'em** against one to three NPCs. No-limit, blinds of 5 and 10, 200 chips each; the most chips after the last hand (10 by default) or the last player with chips wins. How each opponent plays comes from their character: when the game starts, SkyrimNet reads their profile and decides whether they play tight or loose, bold or cautious, and how often they bluff. The board shows it under their name, and they talk the way they play.

When a game starts, your opponents come over to stand in front of you, and their faces are shown in frames on the board.

### SkyrimNet

- **Commentary:** each moment of the game is told to one opponent, who reacts in their own words. Liar's Dice, Shut the Box, Blackjack and Texas Hold'em wait for each line to be spoken before the next move, so the table never talks over itself.
- **They know the game:** while they play, each opponent's prompt holds the state of the game (the `minigame_state` decorator). In Liar's Dice they see only their own dice, keep them secret, and may bluff. A Blackjack dealer alone knows their face-down card. A poker player knows their own cards and their own style.
- **You speak your own moves:** in Liar's Dice your bids and "Liar!" calls, and in Texas Hold'em your folds, checks, calls, bets and raises, can go through Transform Dialogue, so your character says them aloud (MCM option).
- **Challenges:** an NPC may challenge you to Reversi in conversation (the action `Reversi_Challenge`); you can accept or decline.
- Opponents are marked busy while a game is played, so they are not pulled into other conversations.

### Requirements

| Mod | Notes |
|---|---|
| Skyrim SE / AE | Tested on 1.6.1170 |
| SKSE64 and Address Library | |
| Magelight UI 1.0 or later, **or** Prisma UI | Draws the board. One of the two is enough; with both, Magelight UI is used. Tested on Magelight UI 1.7.1 and Prisma UI 1.5.1 |
| SkyrimNet | Beta 28 or later |
| SkyUI and MCM Helper | Settings menu and hotkey |

### How to play

Press the hotkey (**K** by default) to open the menu, pick a game and your opponents, and play. The hotkey or **Esc** closes the board; an unfinished game is offered to continue the next time.

### Installation

Download the archive from the GitHub releases page and install it with your mod manager; `skyrimnet_MiniGame.esp` is ESL-flagged. A Japanese translation is available as a separate archive. In any other game language the mod runs in English.

### Notes

- Leave *Pause the game while playing* off: NPCs cannot speak while the game is paused.
- Liar's Dice and Texas Hold'em take their time, since every bid is spoken before the next one. Each poker opponent's style costs one LLM request when the game starts; your own spoken moves cost one each.
- With ENB or Skyrim Upscaler installed there is no face photo, since saving it crashes the game; the frames show initials. The MCM option *Face photos* also turns it off.

changelog: Texas Hold'em: no-limit, blinds 5 and 10, 200 chips each, up to three opponents. How each opponent plays (tight or loose, bold or cautious, how often they bluff) is read from their character by SkyrimNet when the game starts, and they talk the way they play. The board now runs on Magelight UI (1.0 or later) when it is installed, else on Prisma UI as before; one of the two is enough. Your character can also speak their own poker moves (folds, checks, calls, bets and raises) through Transform Dialogue, like bids in Liar's Dice.
